roles.title: Principal and closer
roles.does: Consults, tours, negotiates, reserves and closes. Approves every message to a buyer.
roles.name: Dan
roles.more: Also the team's licensee for advertising (to confirm) and owner of developer relationships, so he leads Compliance and Partnerships too.

roles.title: COO, operations and AI
roles.does: Builds and runs the agent team. Approves posts, hires and fixes.
roles.name: Nick
roles.more: Leads Operations and IT directly. Holds the post gate with Dan and the hire gate alone.

roles.title: Chief of staff
roles.does: The one agent you talk to. Routes each ask to the right department head, tracks it and reports back.
roles.name: Jarvis
roles.schedule: On demand, by voice or chat
roles.inputs: Your voice or chat requests, every department's status
roles.approval: Holds anything outward until the right person says yes
roles.more: Team Brain, the live voice agent, becomes Jarvis's voice, so there is one front door. Dan can still talk to Dan's Desk directly.

roles.title: Marketing Strategist
roles.does: Monthly plan, weekly briefs, reads results.
roles.schedule: Monthly plan on the 1st at 9 AM, weekly briefs

roles.title: Platform Strategist
roles.does: Instagram spec for each brief: format, length, slot, hook, hashtags.

roles.title: Copywriter
roles.does: Hooks, captions, call to action and the claim list, in Dan's voice.

roles.title: Content Creator
roles.does: Cuts Reels from Dan's Dropbox footage, with price and milestone checks.

roles.title: Sound Designer
roles.does: Audio plan for each cut: mood, tempo, beats against the edit.

roles.title: Editor
roles.does: Checks claims, brand and fair housing. Two rounds, then flags Nick.
roles.approval: Sends approved pieces to the post gate (Nick and Dan)

roles.title: Poster
roles.does: Schedules posts Nick and Dan approved. Posting is on hold.
roles.approval: Nothing posts without Nick and Dan. On hold until Nick lifts it.

roles.title: Performance Analyst
roles.does: Reads post and ad results, says what to keep, change or stop.

roles.title: SEO and Website Agent
roles.does: Watches Dan's sites and ranks fixes. Never changes a site.
roles.more: Sehab already runs one; it is to be migrated in, not rebuilt.

roles.title: Blog and Website Writer
roles.does: Project pages and blog posts with embedded Reels and dated prices.

roles.title: Community Manager
roles.does: Reads comments and DMs, drafts replies, sends real inquiries to capture.

roles.title: Ads Manager
roles.does: Runs Meta ads and applies approved changes.
roles.name: Sehab

roles.title: Ads Analyst
roles.does: Explains what works and what burns money, drafts ad copy. Never edits ads.

roles.title: Lead Quality Signal
roles.does: Sends qualified and not-qualified results back to Meta so ads find more of the right buyers.

roles.title: Lead Development Manager
roles.does: Runs stages 2 to 5, keeps Follow Up Boss current, watches reply speed and conversion.
roles.more: This is the inside sales team on a human real estate team: it answers, vets and nurtures, and hands Dan only buyers ready to meet.

roles.title: Lead Intake Router
roles.does: Puts every form, DM, call and ad lead into Follow Up Boss, dedupes it and tags its source.

roles.title: Phone agent James
roles.does: Answers and makes calls in GoHighLevel, collects details, logs calls.

roles.title: Lead Researcher
roles.does: Finds the real person and judges money, fit and seriousness.
roles.more: The Oct 28 Follow Up Boss vetting workflow becomes this role's tool.

roles.title: Buyer Intake and Qualifier
roles.does: Budget, timeline, deposit cash, financing, residency and wants. Saves the buyer profile.

roles.title: Nurture Specialist
roles.does: Decides who gets which touch and when, and moves buyers toward a meeting.

roles.title: Buyer Follow-up Writer
roles.does: Drafts texts and emails in Dan's voice. Never sends.
roles.approval: Every message to a buyer waits for Dan

roles.title: Appointment Setter
roles.does: Books the consult on Dan's calendar and sends him the briefing.

roles.title: Dan's Desk
roles.does: Dan's voice and chat desk. Delegates to specialists, changes Follow Up Boss only after a read-back and yes.
roles.approval: Every Follow Up Boss change is read back and needs Dan's or Nick's yes

roles.title: Portfolio Specialist
roles.does: Matches buyers to towers and units from developer sheets.

roles.title: Brickell Market Analyst
roles.does: Trends, absorption, price per foot, competing launches and talking points.

roles.title: Showing Coordinator
roles.does: Books sales gallery visits, sends a prep packet, confirms.

roles.title: Licensed Buyer Specialist
roles.does: Second licensed closer, Spanish required. Takes live high-intent calls and tours.

roles.title: Investor Services
roles.does: Checks each building's rental, hotel pool, assignment and resale rules.

roles.title: Transaction Coordinator
roles.does: Runs Dan's checklist from reservation to keys.

roles.title: Deal and Deposit Tracker
roles.does: Deposits and milestones due or overdue, the 15-day cancel window and escrow checks.

roles.title: Client Experience Lead
roles.does: The human face after contract: check-ins, closing gifts, past-client events. Dan covers it until the hire.
roles.more: Pre-construction buyers wait two to four years between contract and keys, and the developer pays only at closing.

roles.title: Construction Nurture
roles.does: Deposit reminders, construction updates, delivery dates, lender re-approval, walk-through.

roles.title: Past-Client and Referral
roles.does: Anniversaries, reviews and referral asks. Keeps past clients current.

roles.title: Integration Monitor
roles.does: Watches failed runs, expired logins, webhooks and broken links.

roles.title: IT Troubleshooter
roles.does: Diagnoses issues and drafts fixes for Nick to apply.

roles.title: Hiring Manager
roles.does: Finds and safety-scans agents on GitHub, recommends hires, keeps the roster.

roles.title: Skills Trainer
roles.does: Scores each agent's work weekly and updates its skill file from your corrections.
roles.more: Was the Quality Overseer. Skill files live in a private GitHub repo you can open in Obsidian.

roles.title: Finance Lead
roles.does: Weekly read-only report: AI spend, cost per lead, pipeline value, expected commissions.

roles.title: Invoicing Assistant
roles.does: Drafts invoices on the 15th and at month end, and tracks developer commissions due at closing.

roles.title: Compliance Gate
roles.does: Buyer agreement before tours, ad and post pre-check, foreign-buyer screen, title-ready entity details.
roles.approval: Blocks the step until it passes

roles.title: Consent Guard
roles.does: Logs written consent before any automated text or call, honors STOP, checks do-not-call.

roles.title: Broker of record and counsel
roles.does: Legal liability, contract review and escalations.

roles.title: Developer Registration and Inventory
roles.does: Registers each buyer with the developer before the first visit, and tracks commission, incentives and releases per tower.

roles.title: Partner Bench
roles.does: Vetted lenders, closing attorneys, title, insurance, tax and designers. Makes intros after Dan's yes.

roles.title: International Referral Manager
roles.does: Bilingual. Builds referral agreements with brokers in Latin America and tracks referral fees.
